assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repository category concept artwork, not claimed model output. assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: repository storyboard category concept art, not claimed model output. Create one 16:9 landscape image consisting of exactly nine equal rectangular frames in an immaculate 3 by 3 storyboard grid with thin dark gutters, no captions. Cinematic painterly science-fiction storyboard telling one coherent story: a lone adult astronaut in a cream suit with orange shoulder panels and mirrored round helmet discovers a glowing teal plant in a red desert at dusk. Reading left to right top to bottom: 1 extreme-wide astronaut tiny amid dunes and distant rock spires; 2 medium rear shot astronaut walking toward faint glow behind rock; 3 close-up boot stopping beside a tiny teal root; 4 over-shoulder view revealing single delicate glowing plant; 5 close-up intact glowing plant with translucent leaves; 6 medium side view astronaut kneeling beside plant, hand hovering without touching; 7 close-up teal light reflected in mirrored visor; 8 wide view astronaut rising as dusk turns blue; 9 extreme-wide final view solitary astronaut beside plant under first stars. Strong, unambiguous progression of shot sizes. Same astronaut suit, same plant, same desert throughout. Each frame richly composed and visually readable, elegant red sand/teal contrast. No text, numbers, UI, labels, logos or watermark.
